item.title: Readers pay tribute to Jeb Bing
item.description: After the Pleasanton Weekly shared news last week of editor emeritus Jeb Bing's death during the holiday season, dozens of readers shared remembrances of our founding editor in comments on social media. Here is a snapshot...

item.title: Foothill alum, Giants’ star Brandon Crawford named to sports hall of fame
item.description: Brandon Crawford, the decorated former San Francisco Giants’ shortstop and a Peninsula native, is one of five athletes slated for induction into the Bay Area Sports Hall of Fame this spring.

item.title: News Digest: Martin Luther King legacy event | Airport unveils new public art | Job expo coming to Livermore Library
item.description: Three Valleys Community Foundation is set to host this year's Dr. Martin Luther King, Jr. Legacy Breakfast & Awards on Jan. 26 at the Palm Event Center in the Vineyard. Read that and more in News Digest...

item.title: Discover Diablo series kicking off this month
item.description: With the new year comes a new season of Save Mount Diablo's Discover Diablo programming, consisting of new additions as well as the return of some familiar favorites.

item.title: Updates on Tri-Valley murder cases
item.description: "After reading through the case files, I'm struck at the similarities that arise in our local homicides and those in the national news. Making no judgments on the facts of these cases nor assumptions about how the legal process will play out, it's just hard to ignore common themes like domestic violence, mental health, family troubles, intoxicated driving and more."

item.title: 'Completely innocent': Fencing coaches deny allegations of swindling immigrant instructors
item.description: The owners of a fencing training school in the Tri-Valley are speaking out through their lawyers to deny allegations from Alameda County prosecutors that they bilked prospective immigrant instructors from Eastern Europe.

item.title: New legislation mandates 'American' labeled wines to use only US grapes
item.description: State legislators from San Rafael and Tracy have introduced a new piece of legislation that would require wine labeled as "American" to be made exclusively from grapes grown in the United States.

item.title: Letters: Repro Rights Gathering | We believe we can | The morality of our president
item.description: "This is not a lecture or a debate. It’s an invitation – to show up as you are, to listen and be heard, to connect over food and shared values, and to remember the strength that comes from being together."

item.title: More than 70 state parks to offer free entry on MLK Day
item.description: More than 70 state parks in and around Bay Area will offer free vehicle entry on Martin Luther King Jr. Day, the California State Parks Foundation announced Friday.

item.title: Pleasanton police vehicle, other car involved in injury collision at intersection near downtown
item.description: A Pleasanton police officer and a civilian driver were injured when a patrol vehicle and another car collided near downtown Saturday afternoon, according to the department.
